title: Choir and Crown
author: Quentin Fairweather
blurb: Vesper Amberdale, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
